newsitem.title: JAPAN: NTT higher after MSCI announcement, media report.
newsitem.headline: NTT higher after MSCI announcement, media report.

text.p: Shares in Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT) rose sharply on Thursday afternoon on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

The rise followed an announcement by Morgan Stanley Capital International (MSCI) that it had added NTT to its Japan index and a British newspaper report on international sales of shares in one of NTT units.
By 0500 GMT, NTT shares were up 77,000 at 972,000 yen, a high for the calendar year.
Its previous high was 914,000 yen marked on January 7.
NTT was the eighth-largest percentage gainer in the first section of the exchange. Turnover was 48,470 shares.
Traders said that the sharp rise was due to MSCI's announcement on Wednesday that it had added NTT to its Japan index and to a report by the Financial Times on Thursday.
The British paper said that NTT's mobile phone unit, NTT DoCoMo, would make an international sale of shares next year that would value it at $20 billion.
NTT shares were bid-only on Thursday morning and were initially traded in the early afternoon at 984,000 yen, up 89,000 from Wednesday's close.
